punchline: Fawcett turned out partly right about a lost city in the Amazon, and being right cost him his life.
thirty_sec: In 1925 the British explorer Percy Fawcett set off into the Brazilian jungle with his son and his son's friend, looking for a lost city he called Z. His last letter came from Dead Horse Camp. They were never seen again, and some who searched died or vanished. David Grann's book says archaeologists later found evidence of large settlements in the Amazon.
